svg.text: Four-Case Composed Latency Ladder (NVIDIA B200, Measured)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 1 (Config): Live config reconfig 3.70-5.15 ms to applied (7 vLLM models, up to 491.1 GiB TP4)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 2 (Python): Live code swap 57.9-92.0 ms typical/median (0.6B-65.5 GB TP1 & 491.1 GiB TP4)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 3 (Graphs): Selective recapture 0.50-3.69 s (vLLM to 491 GiB TP4; SGLang 0.85-1.23 s; MoE 10.52 s)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Case 4 (Crash): Shadow 0.31-1.86 s vLLM / 0.10-0.37 s SGLang resume; 2.73-6.96 s GMS/0.6B CRIU

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (GMS shrinks 14B-65.5 GB ckpts 4.54x-9.67x across vLLM & SGLang; SGLang 65.5 GB restore drops 41.1s -> 4.48s.)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [2] 65.5 GB tier uses deterministic dummy BF16 weights (32.76B Qwen3ForCausalLM). Correctness: logprobs=5 max_abs_diff == 0.0 (vLLM & SGLang) and 3/3 bit-exact (TRT-LLM).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [3] SGLang GMS+CRIU (0.6B/14B/65.5 GB) uses local non-pauseable torch.cuda.graph shim + SglangLab decode override (52 decode graphs ON; prefill disabled vs. breakable Plain).
